purpose: Qualify a fresh, world-disjoint ten-stratum corrective train/validation topology source before any mesh, sensor sample, teacher label or training is produced.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 topology-only audit of all predeclared C13-C24 slots.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly replied '批准' after the exact 120-candidate, 10-train plus 10-validation, topology-only, <=2 CPU-hour and <=2 GiB scope was presented.

source.recipe: The ten frozen Gate-0 V2 structural strata and unchanged bounded-resampling contract.
source.historical_exclusion: All valid V2 C01-C12 canonical identities plus all five pilot identities.

worlds.candidate_slots: 10 strata x C13-C24 = 120 predeclared coordinate-bearing topology candidates
worlds.selected_corrective_train: First valid candidate per stratum; target 10 worlds
worlds.selected_corrective_validation: Second valid candidate per stratum; target 10 worlds

sampling.candidate_indices: C13 through C24 inclusive in every stratum
sampling.selection: First two machine-valid candidates by numeric index; no result-dependent extension.

baseline: The V2 C01-C12 candidate audit is the generator/replay baseline; the failed AEE same-pose parity conclusion motivates, but does not select, any C13-C24 outcome.
failure_policy: Any missing slot, insufficient valid count, duplicate identity, split collision, replay mismatch, source drift or forbidden read fails the whole audit. No C25 extension, deleted class or relaxed topology contract.
